concept.hr: Amplituda nositelja prati NF signal; u spektru nastaju dva bočna pojasa
concept.en: The carrier's amplitude follows the AF signal; the spectrum gains two sidebands

summary.hr: AM modulator s diodom i titrajnim krugom: izlazni napon u vremenu i njegov spektar, s nositeljem na 10 kHz i bočnim pojasevima udaljenima za NF frekvenciju.
summary.en: A diode AM modulator with a tank circuit: its output over time and its spectrum, a 10 kHz carrier with sidebands as far away as the AF frequency.

what.hr: Simulacija applet_am_modulator.html (sklop AM modulatora s diodom i njegove vrijednosti) i tekst odjeljka o modulatorima (50ohm.de, hrvatski prijevod)
what.en: The simulation applet_am_modulator.html (the diode AM modulator circuit and its values) and the text of the modulators section (50ohm.de, Croatian translation)

changes.hr: Sklop se računa na stranici i crta bez vanjskog simulatora sklopova, prilagođen simdeck kitu, preveden na engleski, dodani spektar s označenim nositeljem i bočnim pojasevima, klizači za NF signal i prekidač za titrajni krug
changes.en: The circuit is calculated on the page and drawn without an outside circuit simulator, adapted to the simdeck kit, translated into English, a spectrum with the carrier and sidebands marked, sliders for the AF signal and a switch for the tank circuit added
